disclaimer: TrustScore is a demonstration of responsible-AI credit decisioning. It is not a real lending tool, not financial advice, and not a loan offer. Decisions shown are simulated.

cost_matrix.units: cost per unit of loan amount (exposure)

definitions.disparate_impact_ratio: min/max selection rate across adequately-sized groups; the 'four-fifths rule' flags a ratio below 0.80
definitions.equalized_odds_difference: max(TPR gap, FPR gap) across adequately-sized groups

fairness.disclaimer: This dashboard reports statistical disparities between groups. It does not establish legal compliance or non-compliance, and it is not a legal opinion.

metric_definitions.pr_auc: Average precision; more informative than ROC-AUC when defaults are rare.
metric_definitions.brier: Mean squared error of the predicted probabilities; lower is better.
metric_definitions.ece: Expected calibration error across 10 probability bins; lower is better.
metric_definitions.selection_rate: Share of a group that is approved.
metric_definitions.tpr: P(approved | repaid) — approval rate among the creditworthy.

limitations: Trained on the public Kaggle Credit Risk Dataset, which is not Nigerian credit data. It demonstrates the system, not a production score for any real market.

Fairness is audited only for attributes present in the data (home ownership, age band, income band, loan purpose, prior default flag). Gender, race/ethnicity, geography and other attributes are not in the dataset and are reported as 'not available'.
Fairness figures are statistical disparities between groups. They do not prove legal compliance or non-compliance.
Counterfactuals are model-generated scenarios, not guaranteed approval conditions.
Performance monitoring is offline/simulated: the public dataset has no live outcome stream.
Deployment targets a serverless environment, so the production model is kept deliberately light (LightGBM only; no SHAP library at runtime).

The measured ROC-AUC is optimistic for a real credit setting: the dataset's loan grade and interest rate are lender-assigned fields that already encode an underwriting judgement, so part of the model's skill is reproducing the lender's own risk tiering rather than independent prediction.

drift.method: Population Stability Index (decile bins for numerics)
drift.note: Offline/simulated: the public dataset has no live outcome stream, so this compares the training split (reference) with the held-out test split (current).
